description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultChannelIdMapper class in the Orleans.BroadcastChannel namespace. The class provides methods to map stream identifiers to grain key identifiers based on binding configurations, supporting different key types like GUID and Int64.

classes.name: DefaultChannelIdMapper
classes.description: Implementation of IChannelIdMapper that maps stream IDs to grain key IDs based on predefined binding rules and key types.

methods.name: GetGrainKeyId
methods.description: Determines the appropriate grain key ID span for a given stream ID based on grain binding configurations and key type.

methods.name: GetGuidKey
methods.description: Creates a GUID-based grain key ID span from the stream ID, optionally including the namespace.

methods.name: GetIntegerKey
methods.description: Creates an integer-based grain key ID span from the stream ID, optionally including the namespace.
